study type: Ancillary analysis of a longitudinal cohort study
cohort: Participants were children from the Vitamin D Antenatal Asthma Reduction Trial (VDAART), consisting of 23 with clinical food allergy, 151 with food sensitization, and 220 controls.
finding: Several classes of bioactive fecal metabolites, including bile acids, steroid hormones, sphingolipids, and caffeine metabolites, were found to be associated with food allergy and/or sensitization in the first years of life.
